title: Ultra Rich American Green Chilli Casserole
description: A rich and velvety plant-based casserole featuring green chilli, perfect for a lazy Sunday, simmered in a nimono style and served in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a blender or food processor, combine the canned green chilli, sauteed onion and garlic, tofu, nutritional yeast, soy milk, cornstarch, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
